name: comp-432
blurb: Tabs styled like browser tabs with rounded top edges.
description: Browser-style tab variant with rounded tops, overlapping layout, and elevated z-index on active tab.
use_when: Interfaces mimicking browser tab behavior or document-like metaphors.
avoid_when: Simple content switching without the browser tab aesthetic.
a11y: Semantic tabs with keyboard navigation via radix-ui Tabs component.
